mission: Y Combinator helps founders start companies through funding, advice, and a powerful alumni network.
description: Apply to a YC batch with a founding team and clear problem thesis. Rolling applications; bio/health startups are welcome when the idea is ready.

mission: Y Combinator funds and supports early-stage startups across industries, including bio and health.
position: YC Jobs — roles at YC-backed startups
description: Job board of openings at YC companies. Filter for bio/health roles that match your skills and apply to a specific live posting.

mission: NSF I-Corps trains researchers to test commercial potential of deep science and engineering ideas.
description: Customer-discovery training for academic teams commercializing research. A common first structured step from lab idea to startup hypothesis.

mission: BioLabs provides shared lab infrastructure and community for early-stage biotech companies.
position: Join a BioLabs site / resident company pathway
description: Shared lab and startup community for scientist-founders needing bench space and peer support (including NYC-area sites when available).

mission: CDL is an objectives-based program for massively scalable science- and tech-based ventures.
description: Mentorship program with health/bio-related streams depending on site and year. Apply to an open stream that fits your venture stage.

mission: Breakout backs scientific founders building transformative deep-tech and life-science companies.
position: Program / firm opportunities listed by Breakout
description: Science-focused venture firm/program site. Check for active application calls before submitting materials.

mission: NIH SEED helps small businesses turn promising technologies into products that improve health.
description: Non-dilutive US government funding path for early-stage health/biotech companies. Review current solicitations and eligibility before applying.

mission: IndieBio helps scientist-founders turn biology breakthroughs into companies through funding and lab support.
description: Biology-focused startup program under SOSV. Use the current SOSV apply flow and confirm IndieBio track availability for your cohort.
